limits: Coordinates are an AlphaFold single-chain prediction, not an experimental structure or verified dimer interface.
Mature view hides residues 1–868 of the full precursor prediction; it does not predict maturation-induced rearrangements.
No substrate, water, glycans, membrane or experimental protonation states are present in the protein model.
Covalent bonds are reconstructed from frozen official CCD amino-acid tables; carboxylate resonance/aromatic bond orders are representational, not measured electronic states.
Domain regions are UniProt homology annotations, not experimental domain packing measurements.

rules.residue: named CCD heavy-atom pairs present in source

limitations: CCD single/double orders and aromatic flags are drawing conventions; no site-specific protonation or localized electronic state is inferred.
Only source heavy atoms are retained. No H, formal charges, terminal atoms, disulfides, waters or coordinate replacements are added.
Distance checks only guard named source edges; no proximity-based all-atom bond search is performed.
The coordinate file remains the frozen AlphaFold v6 prediction, not an experimentally verified protein structure or assembly.
